x: … Arthur Clark, who took the lead at the start, was never headed and finished comparatively fresh, a comfortable winner. P. Klophin, whose merits had, to some extent, preceded him, did very well to finish fourth, close behind H.…
It is regretted, but none the less definite, that neither A. Clark or P. Klophin are eligible for inclusion owing to the existent rules for team racing.
Paul Klophin was in the 4 miles race, but after a couple of miles he was seen to fling himself on the grass in despair. Never mind Paul, the " Country " will be with us in a little while.
